about:
I'm a senior React Native engineer based in Nairobi, currently building the mobile banking app at Diamond Trust Bank — the kind of app where a dropped frame or a biometric edge case is a production incident, not a bug ticket.

Most of my last five years have gone into that discipline: bridging device hardware and biometrics with TypeScript mobile architecture, keeping apps usable offline, and passing security audits rather than just clearing them. I've done the same thing for a carbon-offset app with M-PESA payouts and a personal house-hunting app, and shipped the frontend for legal and civic platforms used across Africa.

I've worked with teams in Nairobi, Lagos, Hong Kong, and fully remote AI teams through Turing — different codebases, same habit of asking what happens when the network drops or the fingerprint sensor fails.

Currently open to senior React Native and mobile architecture roles.
